conventions.coordinates: scene pixels; every background has an 8 px dark border, so content (0,0) is scene (8,8). Camera values are the top-left of the 160x144 view (what GB Studio camera events take in pixel units).
conventions.actors: positions are the top-left of the 16x16 sprite frame in scene pixels. Calibrate once: if GB Studio draws the actor offset (usually 0 or 8 px in y), add that constant to every position.
conventions.frames: at = frame offset from the start of the shot. Shots start on the music cue, so drift never accumulates past one shot.
conventions.palettes: palette_ids[i] is the scene palette slot i at load. set_background_palettes changes only the listed slots (others: keep).
